Why aren't people finding my apartment complex online?

Short answer

Renters usually can't find an apartment community for one of three reasons. Either the property doesn't show up where renters search, the information they find isn't convincing, or booking a tour is too hard. Renters search on Google Maps, listing sites, social media and AI tools.

The SocialDM · Nov 11, 2026
The problem

The most common causes

01You show up when someone types your exact name, but not for searches like "2 bedroom apartments in Scottsdale" or "pet friendly apartments near me."
02Your Google Business Profile has the wrong category, missing amenities or old photos.
03Prices, specials or floor plans don't match across your website and listing sites.
04Nearby communities have more recent reviews and more local content than you do.
05Social media looks good but rarely connects the property to its neighborhood.
06AI tools like ChatGPT don't have enough clear facts about your community to recommend it.
07Reporting shows views and impressions, not calls, tours and applications.
What it costs youEvery renter who doesn't find you tours a competitor instead, and you pay for that gap in concessions and days on market.

FAQ

Questions we hear

Is it my website or my Google listing?

Usually both. Renters often decide from Google and listing sites before they ever reach your website.

Do I need more ads?

Not always. Many communities lose renters they could win without extra ad spend in Maps and AI search.

How do I know where I stand today?

A visibility check compares you with nearby communities on the searches renters actually use.
